result.description: Switch Automation Pty Ltd   About Us   Switch Automation is a Sydney-founded, global technology company with offices in Sydney, the USA, UK, Singapore and the Philippines. We develop software for decarbonising and digitising buildings, with over 6,500 buildings on our platform and more than 200 million square feet of real estate under management, serving global financial institutions and leading commercial real estate companies. Our Sydney office, founded in 2005, is our global software development headquarters.   Role Summary   We're looking for a customer-facing Digital Building Engineer to successfully on-board and manage clients on the Switch Smart Building Platform. You'll work closely with other Switch engineers and our development team to deliver customer projects and continuously improve our platform capabilities.   Duties   Primary Duties  •    Implement and configure of the Switch Platform for client specific sites and portfolios by integrating new buildings and building systems into the Switch Platform  •    Configure fault detection and performance optimization logic  •    Perform engineering analysis on building systems to identify and register performance issues and propose improvements and optimization opportunities  •    Conduct regular meetings and communications with building site teams and vendors to drive action on performance optimization opportunities  •    Design and build visualizations to support customer programs and key impact metrics  •    Train new users and provide ongoing software support to customers  •    Provide project support for data integration, ongoing collection, manipulation and analysis: from hardware (meters, control systems, Switch Appliances) to software and flat files  •    Perform project and account management responsibilities to drive customer success  •    Provide software feedback and testing to the product team using your expertise to suggest meaningful improvements to the Switch Platform   Secondary Duties   •    Develop commercial and solutioning skills for interactions with perspective customers as part of demonstrations  •    Learn and develop technical training materials for internal and external users of the software  •    Constantly update knowledge and learning of the industry, the competitive landscape, the Switch Platform and ancillary technologies through ongoing personal development  •    Foster and promote fellow team members by sharing information, education, learnings and introductions  •    Schedule tasks for younger members of the team and provide feedback/training to upskill the team   Skills, Qualifications & Experience   Minimum requirements:  •    Degree in Mechanical Engineering, or Energy Engineering or in a similar major;  •    2+ years' experience in the building services industry, with strong attention to detail;  •    Working knowledge of HVAC systems and controls strategies;  •    Confident leading meetings and engaging directly with customers.   Highly regarded (not essential):   •    Data skills (KQL, SQL, Python);  •    Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders;  •    Commercial acumen and understanding of property operations;  •    CCNA or networking knowledge.      Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $80000-90000   Job Publish:  13-07-2026   Job Expire:  12-08-2026  Apply on:  Digital Building Engineer Job here!    This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.
